identity: You wake up to the sounds of music outside of the house you are in.  When you exit the house, it is still the dead of night, but you can see a house across the way, well lit and open with people moving between the open doors.  Your dead relatives find you at the buffet and berate you for eating the food and drinking the drink at this party.

identity:
Greetings,
Thank you for your participation in the development of the PATIENT MOSAIC process.  Your work here will advance the foundation of human understand of the inner workings of the mind.

The PATIENT MOSAIC personality updating process allows the mathematician to change the fundamentals of their personality.  To turn a wallflower to the life of the party, to get rid of your deepest anxieties or fears, to cure depression instead of managing it with therapy or medication.  With refinement, all of these things will not only be possible, but easy, and you will be one of the people who makes it possible.

At the moment, PATIENT MOSAIC has two primary points of difficulty which you, as a participant, must be aware of.  The first is that it can only be executed by the mathematician upon themselves.  Despite continued progress in the functioning of the process, PATIENT MOSAIC cannot make even the smallest change on another person as of yet.  The second is that the mind is a complex thing and despite the new understanding that GRAY DAWN has brought to us, there is still much to learn.  Small changes can have unexpected ripple effects, leading to undesirable outcomes.  It should be stressed that none of these outcomes are irreversible, but due to the first point, any adverse effects incurred as as a result of the process must be reversed by you; XEDRA researchers and mathematicians cannot assist you except to diagnose any problems that may have resulted.

We welcome your assistance on this endeavor to expand the frontiers of human knowledge and thank you for your efforts toward the goals of Project PHAVIAN.
